title: May says she’s asked Democrats to pull attack ads accusing McCarron of police brutality
summary: State Senator Rachel May requested that a Democratic group cease running attack advertisements against her Republican opponent that reference police brutality allegations. This represents an internal political development regarding campaign messaging strategy and does not directly impact Syracuse city operations or the CIO's purview.
